title: Settings
sectionGeneralLead: Language, what opens first, and the home dashboard.
sectionPlaybackLead: Which player opens streams and how it behaves.
sectionPlayersLead: Where mpv and VLC live, and extra arguments to pass them.
sectionEpgLead: Program guide sources and how the guide is shown.
sectionMetadataLead: Posters, plots and ratings from TMDB for movies and series.
sectionAppearanceLead: Light, dark, or follow your system.
sectionRemoteLead: Control playback from a phone on the same network.
sectionBackupLead: Move your sources and favorites to another install, or keep a copy.

languageHint: Used for menus and labels. Channel names stay as your provider sends them.
startupRestore: Return to where I left off
coverSizeHint: Size of movie and series posters in grids.
dashboardHint: Choose which rows appear on the home screen.
downloadsHint: Movies and episodes you download for offline viewing.
downloadsFolderHint: New downloads are saved here. Downloads already in progress keep their folder.
downloadsFolderHintServer: A full folder path on the computer running the server. Press Enter to save.
downloadsFolderReset: Downloads folder reset to the default
capabilitiesFailed: Couldn't check which players are available: {{message}}
remoteStatusFailed: Couldn't read the remote control status: {{message}}
showDashboardHint: When off, the app opens on your first source.
playerHint: Opens when you play a channel, movie or episode.
playerBuiltInHint: Plays inside the app. Works for most HLS streams.
playerEmbeddedMpvHint: mpv drawn inside the app window. Handles nearly every format.
playerExternalHint: Opens streams in a separate {{player}} window.
playerNotFound: {{player}} wasn't found. Set its path under External players.
streamFormatHint: Xtream and Stalker only. Switch to TS if HLS streams stutter or fail.
autoplayNextHint: Starts the next episode when one finishes.
upNextRailHint: Lists the following episodes near the end of an episode.
vodAutoFailoverHint: If a movie or episode fails to start, try the other container before giving up.
ambientModeHint: Tints the space around the video with its colors.
fullscreenChannelPanelHint: Shows the channel list at the side when you move the pointer in fullscreen.
showCaptionsHint: Turns on subtitles when a stream has them.
doubleClickHint: A single click selects a channel; a double click plays it.
playerPathsHint: Leave empty to use the copy on your PATH.
playerPathHint: Full path to the program, or empty to search PATH.
playerPathHintServer: A path on the machine running the server.
extraArgsHint: Passed to the player before the stream URL.
epgGlobalUrlsHint: XMLTV guides used for every source, in addition to each source's own.
epgGlobalEmpty: No guide URLs added. Sources can still bring their own.
epgStatusHint: Every guide the app knows about, from settings and from sources.
epgStatusEmpty: No guides yet. Add a URL above or add a source that includes one.
epgViewModeHint: How the guide shows a channel's programs.
tmdbEnabledHint: Sends movie and series titles to TMDB to look up posters and details.
tmdbApiKeyHint: A free v3 key from themoviedb.org, under Settings, API.
tmdbLanguageHint: Language for plots and titles from TMDB.
tmdbCacheHint: Clear it if posters or details look out of date.
tmdbAttribution: This product uses the TMDB API but is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
remoteEnabledHint: Serves a small control page that a phone on your network can open.
remoteEnabledNotRunning: Remote control is on but not running.
remoteLoopbackNote: This address only works on this computer. To reach it from a phone, use this computer's network address with the same port.
backupExportHint: Saves your sources, favorites and settings to a JSON file.
backupIncludeSecretsHint: Off by default, so the file is safe to share.
backupIncludeSecretsWarning: Anyone with this file can sign in to your providers. Keep it private.
backupImportHint: Restores sources from a backup made by this app or IPTVnator.
backupNoSecrets: This backup has no passwords. Xtream and Stalker sources will need them re-entered.
backupMergeHint: Adds sources from the file and keeps the ones you have.
backupReplaceConfirmBody: Your current sources, their favorites and watch history are removed before the backup is imported.
backupWrongVersion: This backup was made by a newer version and can't be read.
shortcutsNote: Shortcuts are paused while you type in a text field.
aboutServerNote: Running as a server. Folders are on the host machine.
aboutCredits: Built on ideas from IPTVnator. Movie and series data from TMDB.
errorUrlInvalid: Enter a full address, like http://example.com/guide.xml.
errorUrlScheme: Only http and https addresses work here.
errorEpgDuplicate: That URL is already in the list.
errorPathNewline: Paths must fit on one line.
errorTmdbKey: That doesn't look like a TMDB key. It should be at least 16 letters and digits.
